using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Authorization.Permissions;
using Volo.Abp.SimpleStateChecking;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Authorization.Permissions.Tests;

public class RequirePermissionsSimpleStateCheckerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Call_GetRequiredService_On_ServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var permissionCheckerMock = new Mock<IPermissionChecker>();
        serviceProviderMock
            .Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IPermissionChecker>())
            .Returns(permissionCheckerMock.Object)
            .Verifiable();

        var contextMock = new Mock<SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProviderMock.Object);

        var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(
            new object(),
            new[] { "Permission1" }
        );

        var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

        // Act
        await checker.IsEnabledAsync(contextMock.Object);

        // Assert
        serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IPermissionChecker>(), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Return_True_When_Single_Permission_Granted_And_RequiresAll()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(new MockPermissionChecker())
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var contextMock = new Mock<SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProvider);

        var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(
            new object(),
            new[] { "Permission1" }
        );

        var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

        // Act
        var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(contextMock.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Return_False_When_Single_Permission_Denied()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(new MockPermissionCheckerDeny())
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var contextMock = new Mock<SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProvider);

        var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(
            new object(),
            new[] { "Permission1" }
        );

        var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

        // Act
        var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(contextMock.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Return_True_When_Multiple_Permissions_AllGranted_And_RequiresAll()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(new MockPermissionChecker())
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var contextMock = new Mock<SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProvider);

        var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(
            new object(),
            new[] { "Permission1", "Permission2" }
        );

        var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

        // Act
        var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(contextMock.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Return_False_When_Multiple_Permissions_NotAllGranted_And_RequiresAll()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(new MockPermissionCheckerPartial())
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var contextMock = new Mock<SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProvider);

        var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(
            new object(),
            new[] { "Permission1", "Permission2" }
        );

        var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

        // Act
        var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(contextMock.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Should_Return_True_When_Any_Permission_Granted_And_NotRequiresAll()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(new MockPermissionCheckerPartial())
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var contextMock = new Mock<SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>>();
        contextMock.Setup(c => c.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProvider);

        var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object>(
            new object(),
            new[] { "Permission1", "Permission2" },
            requiresAll: false
        );

        var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

        // Act
        var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(contextMock.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }
}

public class MockPermissionChecker : IPermissionChecker
{
    public Task<PermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string name)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(PermissionGrantResult.Granted);
    }

    public Task<MultiplePermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string[] names)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(new MultiplePermissionGrantResult(names.ToDictionary(n => n, n => PermissionGrantResult.Granted)));
    }
}

public class MockPermissionCheckerDeny : IPermissionChecker
{
    public Task<PermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string name)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(PermissionGrantResult.Denied);
    }

    public Task<MultiplePermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string[] names)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(new MultiplePermissionGrantResult(names.ToDictionary(n => n, n => PermissionGrantResult.Denied)));
    }
}

public class MockPermissionCheckerPartial : IPermissionChecker
{
    public Task<PermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string name)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(PermissionGrantResult.Granted);
    }

    public Task<MultiplePermissionGrantResult> IsGrantedAsync(string[] names)
    {
        var results = names.ToDictionary(n => n, n => n == "Permission1" ? PermissionGrantResult.Granted : PermissionGrantResult.Denied);
        return Task.FromResult(new MultiplePermissionGrantResult(results));
    }
}
